claims.scope: FlashAccountant lock settlement during a swap with a non-standard token

preconditions.text: A lock is active and debts recorded during the lock must be settled to zero before the lock concludes.; The input token has non-standard behavior such as fee-on-transfer, so the pool receives less than the requested amount.; The Router attempts to collect swap payment using payFrom with a snapshot-and-diff mechanism.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: All debts recorded during a lock must be settled to zero before the lock concludes, so a lock must not pass while any recorded debt remains unpaid.; An address must not be able to modify its own debt record for the current lock without authorization.; Pools must never become insolvent in the other token due to non-standard behavior in one token.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: The pool pays out the output asset as if fully paid while receiving less than the required input assets, suffering a loss equal to the tax.
